caption: Our Starter trial at $14.99 a month: AI descriptions, bulk actions, offers and Poshmark, Depop and Grailed sharing are not included.
We created a draft item with one click on Save after filling eight required fields, in about 3 minutes.
Send Offers is locked on Starter: the page says the plan does not include it and asks you to upgrade.
Cancelling starts from Account and Subscription; after this dialog came a retention screen and a required reason and feedback form.
After we confirmed, Vendoo said the plan stays active until the trial ends and nothing more is charged.
